scripts.desktop:dev: uv run --frozen python scripts/package-engine.py && tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: uv run --frozen python scripts/package-engine.py && uv run --frozen python scripts/application-dependencies.py --fetch-locked && tauri build -- --locked
scripts.desktop:build:windows: uv run --frozen python scripts/package-engine.py --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && uv run --frozen python scripts/application-dependencies.py --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --fetch-locked && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis -- --locked
scripts.desktop:build:linux: uv run --frozen python scripts/package-engine.py --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && uv run --frozen python scripts/application-dependencies.py --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --fetch-locked && tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles deb,appimage -- --locked
scripts.desktop:build:macos: uv run --frozen python scripts/package-engine.py && uv run --frozen python scripts/application-dependencies.py --fetch-locked && tauri build --bundles app,dmg -- --locked
